description: This file defines the ActivitiesRelationship class, a specialized extension of OneToManyRelationship, used to manage metadata for activity-related relationships within SuiteCRM. It includes methods to build labels, vardefs, subpanel definitions, and relationship metadata, focusing on handling activity and history subpanels, link fields, and relationship metadata specific to activity relationships.

classes.name: ActivitiesRelationship
classes.description: A class managing metadata for one-to-many activity relationships, including label generation, vardef creation, subpanel and relationship metadata definition, and specific handling of activity and history subpanels.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an instance with provided relationship definitions, calling parent constructor.

methods.name: buildLabels
methods.description: Constructs display labels for the relationship, adding labels for activity types and modules unless 'relationship_only' is true.

methods.name: buildVardefs
methods.description: Builds and returns vardef definitions for link fields on both lhs and rhs modules involved in the relationship.

methods.name: getLinkFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a link field definition array for a given source module and relationship name, with optional parameters.

methods.name: buildFieldsToLayouts
methods.description: Determines which fields should be added to module layouts based on the relationship configuration.

methods.name: buildSubpanelDefinitions
methods.description: Generates subpanel definitions for activities and history, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: buildRelationshipMetaData
methods.description: Creates metadata definitions for the relationship, including involved modules, tables, keys, and relationship type.

methods.name: buildActivitiesSubpanelDefinition
methods.description: Constructs the subpanel configuration for activities collection, including top buttons and collection list.

methods.name: buildHistorySubpanelDefinition
methods.description: Constructs the subpanel configuration for historical activities, including relevant modules and get_subpanel_data references.
